result:
Clean. `.env.local` was removed, no stray processes, and the working tree only shows the expected additions/modifications (the other untracked items like `vite.config.js`/`eslint.config.js`/`dashboardService.js` pre-existed from prior tasks, not mine).

## Summary

Implemented **T-NEW-CONTRACT-PAGE-UI**: `NewContractPage` plus its five owned components (`ContractTypeIndustryTemplateSelector`, `UploadThirdPartyPaperControl`, `CounterpartyPanel`, `ContractDetailsForm`, `NewContractAccessGuard`), wired to all six contracted endpoints through new/extended service modules, a `contractDraftSlice` zustand store, and six hooks. Covers mandatory-field validation with red highlighting, active-template filtering, Template/Upload mutual exclusivity, file format/size checks, GST/Tax ID duplicate detection, date validations, conditional Notice Period, role-gated access, and Save-as-Draft.

- Lint, build, and all 19 tests (8 new) pass.
- Screenshot comparison against the target design (IMG-2/IMG-3) shows a close match on layout, field order, and copy.
- Result written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-NEW-CONTRACT-PAGE-UI.json` (status `SUCCESS`) with 6 documented blockers covering inferred query params, the duplicate-GST flow, an API-layer error-shape conflict between CLAUDE.md and the module DTOs, the Dashboard not rendering the access-denied redirect message (out of my scope), an ambiguous equal-dates message, and the implicit counterparty-creation-at-Save judgement call.
